{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-SMELL-REPAIR",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "The workflow performs heavy installation steps (arduino-cli installation, core installations, and library installations via `make install`) on every run. I am implementing a caching strategy for the `arduino-cli` binary and the Arduino core/library directories to reduce redundant network and CPU usage. The cache key is based on the runner OS and the `Makefile` which defines the installation dependencies.",
  "workflow_yaml": "on:
  push: null
  pull_request: null
  workflow_dispatch: null
name: Test
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Append Path
        run: echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Cache Arduino CLI and Cores
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.local/bin/arduino-cli
            ~/.arduino15
            ~/Arduino/libraries
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-arduino-${{ hashFiles('Makefile') }}
      - name: Test
        run: |
          # ensure bin directory
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
          
          # install arduino-cli into "$HOME/.local/bin" if not cached
          if [ ! -f "$HOME/.local/bin/arduino-cli" ]; then
            curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arduino/arduino-cli/master/install.sh | BINDIR="$HOME/.local/bin" sh
          fi
          
          # prepare config
          arduino-cli config init
          arduino-cli config add board_manager.additional_urls https://arduino.esp8266.com/stable/package_esp8266com_index.json
          arduino-cli config add board_manager.additional_urls https://raw.githubusercontent.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/gh-pages/package_esp32_index.json
          
          # install
          make install
          
          # link library
          mkdir -p ~/Arduino/libraries
          ln -s $PWD ~/Arduino/libraries/.
          
          # build examples
          make build
"
}
